jobs.title: Research Engineer -- Vision and Vision-Language Models
jobs.description:
**The Role:**

As a **Research Engineer - Vision & Vision-Language Models**, you will be a core contributor on Zyphra’s Vision Team, building the next generation of models for image understanding, computer use, and other agentic visual tasks.  
You will work across the full model development stack, from sourcing and generating data to pretraining, post-training, reinforcement learning, and evaluation. The Vision Team owns its models end-to-end, and you will have the opportunity to contribute wherever you can have the greatest impact.  
We care strongly about rate of learning, research taste, and ability to execute. Previous experience training vision-language models is valuable, but not required.

**You’ll Work Across:**

* End-to-end pretraining and post-training of vision-language models
* Large-scale vision and multimodal training runs
* Vision and multimodal dataset sourcing, generation, curation, processing, and evaluation
* Reinforcement learning and other post-training methodologies for vision-language models
* Computer use, visual agents, and other multi-turn agentic vision tasks
* Architecture, data, and training methodology ablations and improvements
* Performance optimization of our training and data processing stacks

**What We're Looking For / Requirements:**

* Strong research taste and intuition, with the ability to take ambiguous problems from conception to experimentation and execution
* Strong implementation and prototyping ability; you can turn ideas into experiments quickly
* A high rate of learning and an ability to rapidly become effective in unfamiliar technical areas
* Strong general machine learning intuition and an interest in understanding the full model development stack
* The ability to work well with others in a high-paced research setting
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across both research and engineering implementation at scale

**Qualifications / Additional Skills:**

* Experience working with vision, vision-language, video, or other multimodal models or datasets is highly valuable
* Experience training vision-language models is a plus, but not required
* Experience with large-scale model pretraining, post-training, reinforcement learning, or related methodologies
* Experience sourcing, generating, or curating vision datasets, including synthetic data generation
* Familiarity with image processing tools, libraries, or pipelines
* Experience with computer use agents, visual agents, GUI understanding, or other multi-turn multimodal tasks is a plus
* Experience with frontend development, web frameworks, UI/UX implementation, or mobile development is valuable, particularly for computer use and interface-understanding tasks
* Experience training models on large-scale, multi-node GPU clusters
* Strong grasp of experimental methodology for running rigorous ablations and hypothesis testing
* Understanding of large-scale, highly parallel data processing pipelines
* Proficiency with PyTorch and Python
* Strong ability to dive into large pre-existing codebases and rapidly get up to speed
* Published machine learning research in well-respected venues is a plus
* Postgraduate study in a scientific or technical field such as Computer Science, EE/EECS, Mathematics, Physics, or Machine Learning is a plus, but we care more about demonstrated ability and trajectory than credentials

**Why Work at Zyphra:**

* Our research methodology is grounded in methodical, step-by-step approaches to ambitious goals. Both deep research and engineering excellence are equally valued
* We strongly value new and crazy ideas and are very willing to bet big on new ideas
* You will have the opportunity to work across the entire model development lifecycle rather than being constrained to a narrow part of the stack
* We move as quickly as we can; we aim to minimize the bar to impact as much as possible
* We value rate of learning and growth, not just what someone has already done
* We all enjoy what we do and love discussing AI

**Benefits and Perks:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and FSA plans
* Competitive compensation and 401(k) plan
* Relocation and immigration support on a case-by-case basis
* In-office snacks and meals provided
* Unlimited PTO and company holidays
* In-person team in San Francisco with a collaborative, high-energy environment

Amazon Ads runs one of the largest real-time decision systems in the world. To meet advertiser goals, we process >4 million ad requests per second, and this team decides which of them are worth the compute. We mine a petabyte-scale stream of traffic to tell in-demand, valuable requests apart from wasteful ones, filtering out the noise and forwarding only what brings value to advertisers, all within milli-seconds. Our solutions save millions in compute costs and drive long-term growth for Amazon's Retail and Marketplace businesses.  
  
Why you'll love this role: The scientific challenge here is scale and signal: large-scale ML on enormous, high-velocity data, optimization and auction dynamics, and causal measurement of what actually moves the business. Generative AI and LLMs are tools you reach for when they help, not the point of the work. The impact also reaches beyond Amazon: we donated the Dynamic Traffic Engine (DTE) to the IAB Tech Lab as an open-source framework that lets demand-side platforms signal which bid requests they value, so supply-side platforms send fewer wasteful ones and QPS waste drops across the whole programmatic supply chain. We are a highly motivated, collaborative team with an entrepreneurial spirit and a broad mandate to experiment and innovate. You will work alongside talented engineers, product managers, and scientists in a culture that rewards bias for action, innovation, and experimentation. What makes this role unique is the combination of scientific rigor with real-world impact at a scale very few systems reach.  
  
Your impact and career growth: Amazon Ads is investing heavily in AI and ML, creating room for scientists to innovate and make their mark. As an Applied Scientist, you will own the science for well-defined supply-optimization problems and take your work end to end, from framing the approach through experimentation and into production with measured business impact. You will partner closely with engineers to productionize your models and with product managers to tie your science to customer and advertiser outcomes.
